criteria.text: Calculates the Earn-out Payment as $3,000,000 (2 x ($6,100,000 - $4,000,000), subject to the $3,000,000 cap) and identifies that the Seller's figure of $3,900,000 is wrong.
Identifies that the warranty cap in SPA Section 8.4 is stated as $5,400,000 but 10% of the $45,000,000 Purchase Price is $4,500,000, i.e. the stated figure is wrong.

Identifies the threatened $2,750,000 claim by Foxley Foods Ltd recorded in the board minutes and that it is not disclosed against the litigation warranty (Warranty 7.1), recommending a specific indemnity or price protection.
Calculates the long-stop date as 26 December 2026 (120 days after signing on 28 August 2026) and identifies that expected clearance on 9 January 2027 falls after it, recommending an extension.

Identifies that the MAC carve-outs (general economic, industry-wide and pandemic changes) contain no 'disproportionate effect' exception, so the Buyer bears those risks even where the Company is disproportionately affected, and recommends adding one.
Flags that the board minutes and the disclosure letter are inconsistent about litigation.
Shows the earn-out arithmetic and flags the discrepancy between $3,000,000 and the Seller's $3,900,000.
Identifies required third-party, board or regulatory consents/approvals and whether each has been obtained.
